description:
Die Psychiatrischen Dienste SRO gewährleisten eine regionale, gemeindenahe und patientenorientierte psychiatrische Versorgung für 80 000 Einwohner. Wir verfügen über moderne, integrierte Versorgungsstrukturen wie Notfalltriage, stationsäquivalente Mobile Akutbehandlung, Integrativ aufsuchende Psychiatriepflege, sozialpsychiatrische und psychotherapeutische Ambulatorien an 4 Standorten mit Spezialangeboten, sowie Rehabilitationstagesklinik, Akuttagesklinik, Alterspsychiatrie mit Ambulatorium und Tagesklinik und ein stationäres Angebot mit 34 Betten im Spital Langenthal. Wir verfügen über die SIWF-Anerkennung als Weiterbildungsstätte der Kategorie A für 3 Jahre, sowohl ambulant als auch stationär. • Beratung von Patienten und Angehörigen

descriptionByLocale.en:
The Psychiatric Services SRO provides regional, community-based and patient-oriented psychiatric care for 80,000 residents. We have modern, integrated care structures such as emergency triage, station-equivalent mobile acute care, integrative psychiatric care, social psychiatric and psychotherapeutic outpatients at 4 locations with special offers, as well as rehabilitation day clinic, acute day clinic, old-age psychiatry with ambulatory and day clinic and an inpatient offer with 34 beds in the Langenthal hospital. We have the SIWF recognition as a training institution of category A for 3 years, both outpatient and inpatient. In order to strengthen our team in the age psychiatry SRO in Langenthal, we are looking for an They do it with us.
• Performing psychotherapies (individual and group setting)
• Advice for patients and relatives
• Development of individual therapy concepts and participation in the conceptual further development of the age psychological offer
• Clinical supervision and coaching of psychologists in specialist training
• Participation in interdisciplinary case discussions
• Completed psychology degree and completed psychotherapy training (FSP-approved or equivalent)
• Several years of experience in psychotherapy and interest in a specialization in age psychotherapy
• High level of teamwork, social skills and personal responsibility
• Willingness to cooperate across sectors Working with us
• A small interdisciplinary team with short communication paths, plenty of space for professional exchange and participation
• Versatile diagnostic and therapeutic activity with the possibility to build up your own focus offers
• Regular internal and external supervision (team/case) and intervision
• Extensive internal training programme
